source: HouseLayout3D manually annotated MP3D CAD layout
axes: native Z-up (x,y,z) -> Habitat (x,z,-y); image columns +native X, rows -native Y = +Habitat Z
floor_classification: Upward normals nz>0.95; at least 5/7 triangle sample points assigned to same MP3D house level using room floor polygons, <=0.25m height error and <=0.35m XY outside tolerance; stair regions excluded as assignment sources
wall_rule: Vertical faces abs(nz)<0.25; section at floor+1.2m; raster stroke 2cm, not a measured physical wall thickness
scope_rule: Published annotated floor polygons, without adding ceiling/furniture support or inferring missing rooms. Strict indoor/outdoor status has not been independently audited.
door_policy: Raw map uses the combined structural CAD mesh without adding separate door polygons or synthetic cuts. The combined mesh may still contain barriers at doors. Separate closed-door and two-sided-support open-door hypotheses are saved; physical door state is unverified.
window_policy: Window annotation remains separate; walls from structural mesh. No ray transparency policy applied.
limitations: Manual annotations still require floor/scope/door-state QA
Comparison is on the same MP3D building, not cross-scene HM3D comparison
No automatic changes to approved datasets, queries, split, rays, or RIR assets

user_review.note: 28개 활용 대상에 포함. 2DFP Free 내부에서 유의미한 RGB observation만 사용하는 조건 유지.
required_before_sampling: Camera position in retained free mask with clearance
View-level usable indoor coverage, depth validity and floor consistency checks
